channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-mac
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: Runner — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source workspace where CLI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI, and pi work one task together as a crew, each in its own real terminal.

item.title: DockLens — via awesome-mac
item.description: Hover a Dock icon to see live thumbnails of all that app's windows, then switch, close or minimize them.

item.title: Digisensus Recorder — via awesome-mac
item.description: Call recorder and bot-free AI meeting note taker for Zoom, Meet, Teams, FaceTime, WhatsApp and phone calls.

item.title: TBD — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source YouTube video and audio downloader built on yt-dlp, which a phone on the same Wi-Fi can also drive.

item.title: Screen Loupe — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source live magnifier that shows any part of the screen zoomed, pixel-true, in a separate window.

item.title: Lotti — via awesome-mac

item.title: Brink — via awesome-mac
